clusters.title: Spain and Gibraltar Celebrate Removal of Border Fence After Historic Treaty

The Pentagon reported that US forces targeted 140 sites in Iran. In retaliation, Iran has reportedly closed the Strait of Hormuz and launched attacks on Gulf states, escalating tensions in the region.
key_facts: US conducted airstrikes on Iran after an attack on a commercial ship.
Pentagon confirmed strikes targeted 140 sites in Iran.
Iran closed the Strait of Hormuz and retaliated against Gulf states.

verification.date_basis: The exact occurrence time was not extracted; date is when Muninn first reported this development.

highlights.title: Trump Announces US Blockade and Tolls in Strait of Hormuz
highlights.summary: President Trump declared that the US will reinstate a blockade in the Strait of Hormuz, positioning the country as the 'guardian' of the waterway. He announced a 20% fee on all cargo shipped through the strait to cover security costs. This declaration comes amid escalating tensions and strikes between the US and Iran, with both nations claiming control over the strategic passage. Oil prices have surged following these developments.
key_facts: Trump announced the US will charge a 20% fee on cargo in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran has rejected US control over the strait amid ongoing military tensions.
Oil prices increased significantly following Trump's announcement.

verification.date_basis: The exact occurrence time was not extracted; date is when Muninn first reported this development.

highlights.summary: The standoff between the US and Iran over the Strait of Hormuz escalated as Iran threatened to block all oil exporting routes in the region. This response follows the US reimposing a maritime blockade on Iranian ports, intensifying the ongoing tensions in the area.
key_facts: Iran threatened to block oil exporting routes in response to US actions.
The US has reimposed a maritime blockade on Iranian ports in the Strait of Hormuz.

Iran has promised strong retaliation against these actions.

timeline_highlights.title: US and Iran Exchange Strikes Amid Tensions Over Hormuz and Blockade
timeline_highlights.summary: Donald Trump has withdrawn a proposed 20% toll on ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz, opting instead for investment and trade deals with Gulf Arab states. This decision comes as US airstrikes target Iranian port cities, while Iran retaliates against Bahrain and Jordan. Amid escalating tensions, Iran has threatened to halt all energy exports from the Middle East in response to a renewed US blockade of its ports, which has led to the closure of the Strait of Hormuz.
key_facts: Trump withdrew a threat for a 20% toll on ships in the Strait of Hormuz.
US airstrikes have targeted Iranian port cities of Bushehr and Bandar Abbas.
Iran has threatened to stop all Middle East energy exports and closed the Strait of Hormuz.

verification.date_basis: The exact occurrence time was not extracted; date is when Muninn first reported this development.
